notes.title: Demo v0.4.26 - Running, Discord server and small fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hello Exorcists! This is a quick update with some pretty cool stuff![/p][p][/p][p]First, our discord server is up! If you'd like to chat with us, give us your feedback or stay in the loop of what is being developed, you can join the server by [url="https://discord.com/invite/Cb528wRbRj" style="button"]clicking here[/url][/p][p]We'd love to see you there![/p][p][/p][p]Second, as we work on larger villages (spoilers!) we decided that it is time to add a [b]run[/b] keybind. We know some people think the game is too slow, so here it is![/p][list][*][p]Walking is the default speed, you can hold [b]SHIFT[/b] to run[/p][/*][*][p]Book keybind was changed to [b]F[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]A couple of fixes also shipping in this version:[/p][list][*][p]Fix training dialogue sometimes not appearing after selecting a relic[/p][/*][*][p]Fix minigame feedback SFX being cut[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That's it for this version, our next update should be e bigger one, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, cheers![/p]

notes.title: v0.4.25 Relic Upgrades System
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, exorcists![/p][p][/p][p]Update 0.4.25 is here to empower your relics and make sure no demon can defeat you! We'd like to introduce the relic upgrades system.[/p][p][/p][p]In the center of the Abbey you can find the [b]Agnus Dei Statue[/b]. Interacting with the statue will open the [b]upgrades screen[/b], and this is where the fun begins.[/p][p]Each relic has 3 different upgrades, and each upgrade has 2 or 3 tiers. So you can go all out in one relic, or upgrade a bit of every relic.[/p][p]You can upgrade things like:[/p][list][*][p]Faster candle movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Gain time back when performing correct inputs in the holy water minigame.[/p][/*][*][p]Crucifix minigame completes faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Slower oil target area.[/p][/*][*][p]Many more![/p][/*][/list][p]Upgrades cost [b]offerings[/b], and you gain offerings by [b]completing exorcisms[/b]. So when going back to the Abbey from your travels, make sure stop by the statue to get your relics upgraded![/p][p][b]Upgrades carry over to martyr relics too[/b]. For example, if you upgrade the standard Crucifix and later you equip St. Beatrice's Crucifix, the upgrades will still apply to the new crucifix![/p][p]The inventory UI was updated to show how many offerings you currently have, and which upgrades have been unlocked for each relic. Hovering the asterisk* icon on the relic name tag will show the relic popup.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the new upgrades system and we'd love to hear your feedback! Feel free to reach out in our community hub.[/p][p]If you liked the demo, leaving a review and adding the game to your wishlist will help us a lot![/p][p][/p][p]Stay strong, exorcists. Until next time![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/d3995d643f461abf3be08d19bb53c46ceae7fff5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/fc549399efb14fa6206b1f921e5871328cf3cc4d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/185633e69f74cf009dffe0a9eac16955695aff57.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/d3ecc2ff71bb223393428d647a7620cd7809ac4d.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: v0.4.12 - New character, better RNG and improved early game
notes.notes: [p]Hello, exorcists! Version 0.4.12 is bringing various small changes:[/p][h3]New villager[/h3][p]In this update we're introducing a new villager, the old bearded man, to start adding more variety to the game.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/e1bf9c3b794438eba43555e5acd7d536e977baf7.png"][/img][/h3][h3]Better RNG[/h3][p]Some people were getting really bad RNG and were always seeing the same villagers and the same demons. So in this update we are also making sure that won't happen anymore. You are guaranteed to see different things before villagers and demons start repeating.[/p][h3]Improved dialogue and objectives[/h3][p]Objectives now are less vague and will do a better job at guiding players through the early game. We also tweaked some of the core lines of dialogue to give players more information about where to go next.[/p][h3]Other changes[/h3][list][*][p]Dialogue box is now at the bottom of the screen. The training exorcism dialogue is still at the top so it won't block any of the gameplay elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a candle bug that could lock players in the minigame.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed two Calebs spawning in Caleb's room.[/p][/*][/list][p]That's it for 0.4.12, we hope you enjoy the changes and give them demons what they deserve![/p][p]See you next time![/p]

notes.title: Demo update v0.4.11
notes.notes: [p]Hello exorcists! This new patch brings a few QoL changes. The main one being the candle minigame.[/p][p]Prior to version 0.4.11, if you moved the candle too fast it would go out, you would then have to hold it still and press Q/RMB until it was lit again. This was a bit confusing and it was also making the candle minigame more complex than the other relics.[/p][p]In this version the candle won't go out anymore. If you move too fast, the candle will start flickering and you won't be able to find the symbol (nor use the distance hint). You have to slow down until the flickering stops.[/p][p]Some other changes include:[/p][list][*][p]World Map: Double clicking a village will highlight the travel button.[/p][list][*][p]Helper for new players trying to understand how the map works.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Concilium now appears as a single entity in the abbey, instead of the 3 members individually.[/p][/*][*][p]Remove horse SFX when you arrive at a location. It was hard to hear on top of the map SFX and some players were mistaking it for a demonic sound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix typos and layout in the prophecy cutscene.[/p][/*][/list][p]All these changes were implemented based on player experience. If you have any feedback don't hesitate to reach out, it helps us a lot![/p][p]See you next time![/p]

notes.title: Demo update v0.4.10
notes.notes: [p]Hello exorcists! Update 0.4.10 brings a few changes aimed at speeding up the early game, allowing you to get to real exorcisms as soon as possible:[/p][list][*][p]Increase movement speed by 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Add option to skip training exorcism.[/p][list][*][p]Not recommended if it is your first time playing! But if you think you got the gist of it you can hold Q to stop the training in the middle of the exorcism.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Show exorcism input hints until you exorcise a demon.[/p][list][*][p]Just a helping hand, especially for those that skipped the training exorcism.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Remove F1 key bind from tutorial popup. H is the only key that opens the tutorial.[/p][list][*][p]No reason for having 2 keys assigned to that action. H can be used on keyboards without function keys.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]We hope these changes help in getting players to the core loop faster. If you have any feedback feel free to reach out![/p][p]See you next time![/p]

notes.title: Demo update v0.4.9
notes.notes: [p]Version 0.4.9 brings a few small QoL updates and fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Training[/p][list][*][p]Reduce the amount of rounds in training minigames.[/p][/*][*][p]Let players see Honey and Crosses tooltips during training dialogue.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Exorcism[/p][list][*][p]Possession will increase faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce number of minigames required to 4, making it less repetitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing a minigame reduces possession by 10% instead of 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Better highlight of empty slots in St. Benedict's medal minigame.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]UI - Fix issue with player marker appearing on top of tooltips on the world map.[/p][/*][*][p]Make tutorial popups keyboard navigation consistent with other screens (close with Esc).[/p][/*][/list][p]If you tried the demo we would love to hear your feedback![/p][p]See you on the next update![/p]

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! The chance for you to become an exorcist has finally arrived![/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to bring to you our first demo! Version 0.4.8 contains the initial chapters of the main story and gameplay mechanics.[/p][list][*][p]Training area in the Abbey.[/p][/*][*][p]World map - Travel to villages affected by evil and exorcise possessed villagers.[/p][/*][*][p]Find new relics with special attributes that give you an advantage in the minigames.[/p][/*][/list][p]In terms of content, this version contains[/p][list][*][p]3 unique demons.[/p][/*][*][p]3 unique possessed characters.[/p][/*][*][p]6 standard and 3 named relics.[/p][/*][*][p]8 small villages.[/p][/*][/list][p]The game is still in development, so it lacks a bit of polish here and there. The current quality does not represent the final version. We are a team of 2 working full time on the game and we will be releasing updates with more and better content.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy the demo and we're eager to hear your feedback![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/26857b8a701e3800899005b1632e6de6a2e12bca.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/0b5303131b8e3e0d5407f5754f122d4c8cb5703e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/a9d5d918758d7291667f1f83679cc95d47dacbf7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598040/9e9c42a44e1d96e6e09a5bc7b080890a25a2fad6.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: Hello from the Tusks And Talons team!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We would like to take this opportunity to introduce ourselves. We are Lady Boar and Indie Talons, the two members of Tusks And Talons Games.

As a small team we wear many hats, but our main roles are:
[list]
[*] Lady Boar - Art and UI.
[*] Indie Talons - Programming and sound design.
[/list]
Game design, narrative and everything else is a shared effort. 

As of now we are self funded and self published, working full time on Blood Of The Lamb, our debut title. We are currently preparing a demo that will be released in the coming months.

If you want to know more about how the game is being developed, you can follow us on our social media pages. We try to post updates of what we're currently working on.
